interpretations.label: Nominal Net Worth
interpretations.description: Total estimated wealth in current USD for each given year without adjusting for inflation.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: USD (United States Dollars) in nominal terms as of the annual valuation date.
caveats: Does not account for inflation over time
Valuations fluctuate with public stock prices and asset values

interpretations.label: Inflation-Adjusted Real Net Worth
interpretations.description: Total estimated wealth adjusted to a common base year currency value to allow historical purchasing power comparisons.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: USD adjusted to a fixed base year using the Consumer Price Index (CPI).
caveats: Inflation adjustment depends on the chosen base year index
General consumer inflation may not reflect asset-class inflation accurately

knownRisks: Inaccuracies in estimating private wealth holdings
Methodological changes in wealth calculation across reporting years
